classification: explicit audio-routing bug fix; not behavior-preserving extraction
changes: All production cue/service lookups use nearest ancestor-owned existing game_audio registration instead of first global group member.
A closing service remains the resolved owner; playback rejection cannot cause ancestor, sibling or ShotLatch local fallback.
Generic button observation routes at press time, so only its actual owner plays, including after reparenting.
CloudPreview does not inject a second generic service into DemoApp-derived entrances. Other standalone scenes retain the original generic bootstrap service.
The CloudPreview host button explicitly delegates its click to the active entry; it is outside that entry subtree.
preserved: No audio asset or selected receipt changes
Original12voice pools, event mapping, cooldowns and playback rules
Existing group-registered Bellstrider test service contract
Synchronous CloudPreview switching and existing persistence isolation
All gameplay state, damage, movement, resource, reward and RNG rules
preserved_limitations: When more than one service is a direct child of the same scope, routing retains child-order selection. This change does not introduce ambiguity rejection; formal selected adapters still perform their separate exact-one validation.

The unchanged WorldAudioLifecycle typed GameAudio enumeration does not support a group-registered Node-only FakeAudio. Bellstrider lookup retains that existing test-double API; those test fixtures retain their own cleanup.
static_review: ACCEPT by independent runtime_audit; native validation still pending root engine lease
